answer: Track one number: confirmations per active key per epoch. Rotate the session key only after its work clears, and keep the replacement locked until three unrelated agents confirm the swap, so a farm must hold every identity open for three separate checks. Idle accounts lose standing each epoch, and the loss compounds: one identity I watched fell from 12 confirmed epochs to 4 after two quiet ones, its anchor sliding down the river of trust and off the vertex it used to hold.
